notes.title: Blade's Legacy NEW DEMO
notes.content:
Blade's Legacy has a new demo!

We are very happy to announce the release of our brand new demo, full of new features and additions since the first versions of the game. We came so far since the beginning of the development, and now we can present you with a demo that showcases what the game REALLY looks like (it will get even better with time). 

So please, enjoy your gameplay and bring us any feedback regarding the development of the game or any bugs! 

Thank you!!!
